MySyndic Brand Identity System

nodes.label: Tropical Teal Palette
nodes.rationale: Teal tropical chosen as trust colour inspired by African fintech (Paystack, Flutterwave); amber and emerald used for states.

nodes.label: get-by-criteria DSL
nodes.rationale: A single query-param DSL per module providing paginated list + filters + sort + projection, replacing fixed list endpoints for the UI.

nodes.label: Session Cite Security Scoping
nodes.rationale: Base security conditions (active cite_id, is_deleted:false, notification user_id) are always ANDed and non-removable; client logic=or applies only between DSL filters so a user cannot filter outside their cite.

nodes.label: Paystack Subaccount per Cite
nodes.rationale: Each cite gets its own Paystack subaccount so local settlement pays each cite directly instead of the master account.

nodes.label: Versioned SQL Migrations
nodes.rationale: init-scripts/mysyndic_db.sql runs only once at volume creation, so versioned .sql migrations applied at API bootstrap and via migrate:run keep existing/shared/prod/test databases in sync.

nodes.label: Migration Runner Service
nodes.rationale: Uses a synchronous pg connection because Prisma $executeRaw does not reliably run multi-command SQL scripts; shared by API bootstrap and the migrate:run CLI, with retry/backoff at first boot.

nodes.label: Prisma ORM (db pull)
nodes.rationale: SQL écrit à la main = source de vérité. prisma db pull régénère le schéma sans dérive DDL; TypeORM exigerait de réécrire tout le DDL en entities TS (duplication).

nodes.label: MinIO Storage Abstraction
nodes.rationale: MinIO S3-compatible en dev, swap Supabase en prod par implémentation de la même interface uploadFile/uploadBase64/getPresignedUrl/deleteFile.

nodes.label: Redis Sessions and RBAC Cache
nodes.rationale: Au login computeSession stocke profils+features dans session:{user_id} avec features_version par profil; RbacGuard lit Redis et vérifie la staleness par version. Pas de hit DB par requête.

nodes.label: JWT Payload MySyndic
nodes.rationale: Payload {sub,email,role,cite_id,must_change_password,iat,exp}; cite_id null pour SUPER_ADMIN. Ajout multi-tenant vs aff-api.

nodes.label: cite_id Scoping Decorator and Interceptor
nodes.rationale: @CiteId() decorator lit le JWT + injection systématique du filtre cite_id dans les queries Prisma; le générateur CRUD ajoute le filtre par défaut. Super Admin (cite_id null) => requête non filtrée.

nodes.label: generate-module.ts Generator
nodes.rationale: Copie du script aff-api + templates hbs adaptés: UUID au lieu d'Int, colonne cite_id scoping, created_by/updated_by depuis JWT, feature code GERER_*.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Dev Stack
nodes.rationale: Services postgres16/mongo7/redis7/minio/api/prisma-sync; init-scripts montés via docker-entrypoint-initdb.d; DB de test mysyndic_test créée au boot.

nodes.label: Audit Log Interceptor
nodes.rationale: Modèle AuditLogInterceptor commun (R9), activation progressive module par module.

nodes.label: Paystack Subaccount per Cite
nodes.rationale: Compte marchand master MySyndic + un subaccount par cité, split automatique à la charge: zéro reversement manuel, une seule paire de clés globale. Alternatives écartées: compte marchand par cité, plateforme encaisse + reverse central (float + ops legales).

nodes.label: Global Paystack Keys in app_config
nodes.rationale: configuration perd paystack_public_key/paystack_secret_key; app_config gagne PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, PAYSTACK_CURRENCY=XOF.

nodes.label: Checkout SIMPLE Mode
nodes.rationale: subaccount: <code> + bearer: account (frais payés par MySyndic, syndic reçoit le net nominal).

nodes.label: Checkout SPLIT Mode
nodes.rationale: Split avec percentage = paystack_subaccount_split de la cité; MySyndic perçoit sa commission sur chaque paiement.

nodes.label: webhook.montant_match Generated Column
nodes.rationale: STORED generated column calculée par PostgreSQL depuis montant_recu/montant_attendu; jamais incohérente car plus d'écriture explicite. NULL = comparaison impossible.

nodes.label: WEBHOOK_PAYSTACK_SECRET Removal
nodes.rationale: Paystack n'a pas de secret webhook séparé: la signature HMAC utilise PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY. WEBHOOK_WAVE_SECRET conservé (distinct).

nodes.label: Paystack Payment Initiation
nodes.rationale: POST /paiements/paystack/init: vérif occupant + villa, refus 409 si déjà CONFIRME, montant = configuration.cotisation_mensuelle, INSERT EN_ATTENTE, appel Paystack initialize avec subaccount_code, retour authorization_url. HTTP client natif fetch, pas de SDK.

nodes.label: Webhook HMAC and Idempotence
nodes.rationale: POST /webhooks/paystack public, vérif X-Paystack-Signature HMAC-SHA512, 200 immédiat, UNIQUE(aggregateur_code,reference) = idempotence (P2002 -> 200 silencieux), signature invalide -> 401.

nodes.label: Async Webhook Processing
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget setImmediate: vérif event charge.success, montant_recu/montant_attendu, si montant_match -> UPDATE paiement CONFIRME + recu_paiement + PDF async + notification + audit.

nodes.label: PDF Receipt Service
nodes.rationale: PdfReceiptService PDFKit: logo, cité, villa, mois, montant, canal, référence, date, QR embed (qrcode npm) vers /verify/{qr_code_token}; upload MinIO bucket documents.

nodes.label: Manual Payment Entry
nodes.rationale: POST /paiements/manuel (feature PAIEMENT_SAISIE_MANUELLE): villa_id, mois[] 1..N, canal manuel, transaction N INSERT CONFIRME direct + reçus + audit; MULTI_MOIS_PAIEMENT_MAX depuis app_config.

nodes.label: Excel Export
nodes.rationale: exceljs streaming, colonnes Villa/Mois/Montant/Canal/Statut/Date/Saisi Par, feature PAIEMENT_EXPORT_EXCEL.

nodes.label: Prisma queryRaw Views
nodes.rationale: Vues v_impayes_mois_courant, v_recouvrement_mensuel, v_historique_paiements_villa non introspectées par Prisma -> $queryRaw typé avec scoping cite_id.

nodes.label: Sprint 3 Generator and Manual Adaptation
nodes.rationale: Générer les 4 modules via generate-module.ts (CRUD scoped + soft-delete) puis adapter à la main pour les workflows métier (escalade, statuts, likes, commentaires arborescents).

nodes.label: Sprint 3 RBAC Feature Mapping
nodes.rationale: Mapping route->feature (ALERTE_*, INCIDENT_*, CONFLIT_*, ANNONCE_*); validation réelle portée par RbacGuard (cache Redis + profil_feature), le décorateur @RequireFeature indique l'exigence.

nodes.label: NotifService
nodes.rationale: Notifications in-app sur événements clés via NotifService.sendToUser; ciblage par rôle/feature aux syndics non implémenté -> différé ou envoi manuel.

nodes.label: Incident Likes (toggle, composite PK)
nodes.rationale: Toggle like/unlike with composite key (incident_id, user_id) guarantees uniqueness and idempotent UX.

nodes.label: Incident Threaded Comments (max depth 2)
nodes.rationale: Cap replies at two levels (parent_id + level 1) to keep threading readable; level 3 returns 400.

nodes.label: Systematic Cite Scoping (cite_id)
nodes.rationale: Every message/document/notification query filters cite_id from JWT session; out-of-cite yields 403/404. cite_id=null (super admin) yields 403. Prevents cross-cite data leakage.

nodes.label: Soft Delete (is_deleted, deleted_at)
nodes.rationale: Entities are never hard-deleted; is_deleted/deleted_at/deleted_by flags hide rows from listing while preserving audit trail.

nodes.label: ChatGateway (socket.io global)
nodes.rationale: Global @WebSocketGateway in src/sockets/ with user:{userId} and cite:{citeId} rooms; JWT handshake auth. Nest HTTP guard rejected as unsuitable for socket lifecycle.

nodes.label: MessageContentService (MongoDB driver)
nodes.rationale: Message content stored in MongoDB collection MONGO_MSG_COLLECTION, referenced by PG message.mongo_doc_id. JSONB-in-PG alternative rejected for chat volume/reactivity.

nodes.label: Redis Read State (msg:read ZSET)
nodes.rationale: Read/unread tracked in Redis ZSET msg:read:{userId} with TTL REDIS_MSG_LU_TTL_DAYS=30. PG flag rejected (no lu column, avoids mass UPDATEs).

nodes.label: Redis Socket.io Adapter
nodes.rationale: @socket.io/redis-adapter for multi-instance pub/sub, with single-node fallback based on REDIS_URL.

nodes.label: NotifService.sendToCite (targeted diffusion)
nodes.rationale: Extends NotifService with sendToCite(cite_id, titre, message, {features?, exceptUserId?}) querying active profiles/profil_feature then sendToUser per target; keeps sendToUser contract (void, silent catch).

nodes.label: notification:new Socket Event
nodes.rationale: Real-time push emitted to user:{userId} room on every notification creation.

nodes.label: MinIO StorageService
nodes.rationale: Documents uploaded to MinIO bucket MINIO_BUCKET_DOCUMENTS, download via presigned URL; reuses existing StorageService.uploadFile/getPresignedUrl.

nodes.label: groupe_cite (auto-created cite group)
nodes.rationale: One group per cite (groupe_cite.cite_id UNIQUE), upserted on first group message, mirroring seed add_user_to_cite_groupe.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Logging
nodes.rationale: One JSON line per event with level/time/msg/pid/hostname/context; pretty output allowed when NODE_ENV !== production.

nodes.label: Correlation ID (X-Request-Id / requestId)
nodes.rationale: pino-http generates req.id, propagated to response header X-Request-Id and error body requestId, linking request/response/error logs. Client echo alternative rejected.

nodes.label: Sensitive Data Redaction
nodes.rationale: Pino redact paths mask Authorization/cookie/password/token/secret/PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY/GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD to [Redacted]; financial amounts intentionally NOT redacted (non-secret).

nodes.label: StripNullInterceptor
nodes.rationale: Global interceptor removes null/undefined keys recursively (objects and array elements) preserving false/0/''; skips StreamableFile, buffers and raw express responses.

nodes.label: GlobalExceptionFilter
nodes.rationale: Handles errors + Prisma exceptions; response.json body is not modified by StripNullInterceptor, keeps statusCode/message/error/detail/timestamp/path and adds requestId.

nodes.label: DateFormatInterceptor
nodes.rationale: Formats dates before StripNullInterceptor runs; null cleanup applied after so absent dates (deleted_at) are dropped while formatted date strings remain.

nodes.label: nestjs-pino + pino
nodes.rationale: LoggerModule.forRoot in AppModule; pino-pretty dev only. Winston and custom Nest logger rejected; nestjs-pino covers Nest + HTTP.

nodes.label: RBAC Features (profil_feature)
nodes.rationale: Feature flags (MESSAGE_SEND_PRIVATE/GROUPE, MESSAGE_DELETE_OWN, DOCUMENT_*, ALERTE_*, etc.) loaded into Redis session for 24h and enforced by existing HTTP guards.

nodes.label: Signalement d'un incident
nodes.rationale: Incident scoped to the citizen's own cite; titre and description required, categorie/villa/photo optional.

nodes.label: Liste et detail d'un incident
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Liste et détail d'un incident
nodes.rationale: List sorted date desc; detail exposes like count, is-liked-by-me, and 2-level threaded comments.

nodes.label: Likes sur un incident (toggle)
nodes.rationale: Toggle semantics; composite key (incident_id, user_id) guarantees uniqueness.

nodes.label: Commentaires arborescents 2 niveaux
nodes.rationale: Max depth 2; replying to level-2 returns 400. parent_id links replies.

nodes.label: Logging structure JSON (pino)
nodes.rationale: JSON active in production; pino-pretty readable output allowed in dev without information loss.

nodes.label: Niveaux configurables LOG_LEVEL
nodes.rationale: ENV LOG_LEVEL trace|debug|info|warn|error, default info; lower levels filtered.

nodes.label: Correlation id par requete
nodes.rationale: Unique id per HTTP request propagated in start/end logs, returned in X-Request-Id header and error body requestId.

nodes.label: Journalisation des requetes HTTP
nodes.rationale: Logs method, url, statusCode, responseTime using req.id/req.method/req.url.

nodes.label: Redaction des donnees sensibles
nodes.rationale: Never log Authorization/cookie, password, password_hash, token, access_token, refresh_token, secret, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD; replaced with [Redacted].

nodes.label: Envoi d'un message prive
nodes.rationale: Metadata in PG, content in MongoDB (mongo_doc_id); est_groupe=false; same-cite constraint; emits socket message:new.

nodes.label: Envoi d'un message de groupe
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Envoi d'un message de groupe
nodes.rationale: est_groupe=true, groupe_id; broadcasts to room cite:{citeId}; groupe_cite auto upserted if absent.

nodes.label: Historique des conversations
nodes.rationale: GET /messages/conversations and /messages/conversations/:userId, date desc, excludes soft-deleted; cross-cite returns 404 to avoid disclosure.

nodes.label: Marquage lu d'un message
nodes.rationale: PATCH /messages/:id/lu stores read state in Redis msg:read:{userId} with TTL REDIS_MSG_LU_TTL_DAYS.

nodes.label: Suppression de son message
nodes.rationale: Soft-delete DELETE /messages/:id sets is_deleted=true and deleted_at; only own messages.

nodes.label: Emission d'une notification temps reel
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Émission d'une notification temps réel
nodes.rationale: Socket notification:new to room user:{userId}; persisted in PG; direct via sendToUser or broadcast via sendToCite.

nodes.label: Diffusion ciblee d'une notification (sendToCite)
nodes.rationale: NotifService.sendToCite targets subsets by RBAC features and can exclude the triggering user via exceptUserId.

nodes.label: Liste des notifications
nodes.rationale: GET /notifications date desc, scoped to user's cites, excludes soft-deleted.

nodes.label: Badge de notifications non lues
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Badge de notifications non lues
nodes.rationale: GET /notifications/badge returns count of lu=false, updated on creation, read and bulk read.

nodes.label: Marquage lu notification
nodes.rationale: PATCH /notifications/:id/lu or /notifications/read-all sets lu=true and lu_at; foreign notification returns 404.

nodes.label: Initiation d'un paiement Paystack
nodes.rationale: Verifies current villa occupancy, reads montant from configuration.cotisation_mensuelle, inserts EN_ATTENTE PAYSTACK, calls /transaction/initialize, returns authorization_url + reference; confirmed (villa,mois) refused.

nodes.label: Reception du webhook Paystack (signature HMAC-SHA512)
nodes.rationale: Public POST /webhooks/paystack; verify HMAC-SHA512 of raw body with aggregator webhook key before any handling; invalid signature stored signature_ok=false and returns 401.

nodes.label: Idempotence proof webhook
nodes.rationale: UNIQUE(aggregateur_code, reference) prevents reprocessing; duplicate returns 200 with no double effect.

nodes.label: Traitement asynchrone du webhook
nodes.rationale: Returns 200 right after signature validation then fire-and-forget: checks montant_match, confirms payment, generates PDF receipt, notifies residents, writes audit.

nodes.label: Saisie manuelle d'un paiement
nodes.rationale: Syndic (PAIEMENT_SAISIE_MANUELLE) enters one or more months for a villa via WAVE_MANUEL/ORANGE_MANUEL/MTN_MANUEL/CASH; capped by MULTI_MOIS_PAIEMENT_MAX; already-confirmed month refused; each month generates PDF receipt.

nodes.label: Historique et statistiques de paiement
nodes.rationale: Villa history identical for all occupants; current-month unpaid and monthly recovery via views filtered by cite.

nodes.label: Recu PDF (PDFKit + MinIO)
nodes.rationale: Each confirmed payment gets a PDFKit receipt (logo, cite, villa, month, amount, channel, reference, datetime, QR verification link) stored on MinIO; URL generated on-demand if absent.

nodes.label: Export Excel des paiements
nodes.rationale: PAIEMENT_EXPORT_EXCEL; columns Villa, Mois, Montant, Canal, Statut, Date, Saisi Par.

nodes.label: Subaccount Paystack par cite
nodes.rationale: configuration stores paystack_subaccount_code, paystack_subaccount_mode, paystack_subaccount_split; SUPER_ADMIN only; constraints ck_subaccount_mode and ck_subaccount_split (1-100).

nodes.label: Cles Paystack globales dans app_config
nodes.rationale: app_config holds PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, PAYSTACK_CURRENCY; configuration drops paystack_public_key/secret_key; WEBHOOK_PAYSTACK_SECRET removed as redundant with PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.

nodes.label: Mode SIMPLE - subaccount plein
nodes.rationale: Checkout initialized with city subaccount code and bearer=account; syndic receives nominal amount net of MySyndic-paid fees.

nodes.label: Mode SPLIT - partage de commission
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Mode SPLIT — partage de commission
nodes.rationale: Checkout uses subaccount with percentage=paystack_subaccount_split so MySyndic earns commission per payment.

nodes.label: Ratio modifiable sans recreation
nodes.rationale: paystack_subaccount_split editable anytime without recreating subaccount; applies to future payments only.

nodes.label: Source de verite recu_paiement
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Reçu PDF — source de vérité recu_paiement
nodes.rationale: recu_paiement is the sole table for receipt data (file_path, qr_code_token, generated_at); paiement stores no receipt path; presence via join/EXISTS; v_historique_paiements_villa exposes recu_file_path.

nodes.label: Montant match generated column
nodes.source_location: Requirement: Vérification du montant du webhook
nodes.rationale: webhook.montant_match is a STORED generated column: montant_recu = montant_attendu when both non-NULL else NULL; never written directly.
